function.name: compute_tax
function.description: Calculates the tax based on the taxable income and filing status of an individual. It also considers the state of residence to apply state-specific tax rules. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

taxable_income.description: The individual's income subject to tax, before any deductions or exemptions, in USD. This is a float type value.

filing_status.description: The taxpayer's filing status which determines the rate at which income is taxed.

state_of_residence.description: The U.S. state where the taxpayer is a resident, which affects the calculation of state taxes.

deductions.description: The total amount of deductions the individual is claiming, which will reduce the taxable income, in USD. This is a float type value.

exemptions.description: The number of exemptions claimed by the taxpayer, reducing the taxable income further.

tax_year.description: The tax year for which the tax calculation is being performed. It defaults to the current year if not specified.

Shashi Tej Reddy (born 1975) is an Indian entrepreneur and philanthropist best known for founding **Reddy’s Foods**, a leading manufacturer of ready-to-eat meals and snacks in India. He grew up in Hyderabad, studied engineering at Osmania University, and later earned an MBA from the University of Texas at Austin.

After working in the food industry for several years, Reddy launched Reddy’s Foods in 2008 with a focus on high‑quality, affordable products. Under his leadership, the company expanded rapidly, introducing a range of instant noodles, soups, and frozen meals that gained popularity across India. Reddy’s Foods has been recognized for its commitment to sustainability, using locally sourced ingredients and eco‑friendly packaging.

Beyond business, Shashi Tej Reddy is active in social causes. He established the **Reddy Foundation**, which supports education and healthcare initiatives in rural communities. The foundation runs scholarship programs, builds schools, and funds medical camps to improve access to quality services for underprivileged children.

Reddy’s entrepreneurial journey has earned him several accolades, including the “Young Entrepreneur of the Year” award by the Confederation of Indian Industry (CII) and recognition as one of Forbes India’s “30 Under 30” in the Food & Beverage category.
